page_title: A press conference of Tatmadaw True News Information Team on 18 January 2019.jpg
file_title: File:A press conference of Tatmadaw True News Information Team on 18 January 2019.jpg
description: General Zaw Min Tun (at the far right center), General Soe Naing Oo (in the middle), and General Tun Tun Nyi (on the left) discussing military operations during a press conference held by the Tatmadaw True News Information Team at the Military History Museum in Naypyidaw on Friday, January 18, 2019. The press conference addressed the ongoing conflict with the Arakan Army (AA) in Rakhine State, where the AA had reported a temporary calm after days of fighting. During the event, representatives from the AA refuted the Tatmadaw's claims about their operational bases, asserting their presence within the local community. The discussion reflected the ongoing tensions and political dynamics in Myanmar's conflict landscape.

description: General Zaw Min Tun attending a press conference held by the Tatmadaw True News Information Team at the Military History Museum in Naypyidaw on January 18, 2019. The press conference, which also featured General Soe Naing Oo and General Tun Tun Nyi, addressed the conflict with the Arakan Army (AA) in Rakhine State. Zaw Min Tun, as the military spokesperson, discussed the Tatmadaw's operations and the temporary calm reported by the AA after days of fighting. The event highlighted the contested narratives between the Tatmadaw and the AA, reflecting ongoing tensions in Myanmar’s conflict dynamics.
